The work will be located at our downtown Vancouver office and will involve supporting the continuous development of SaaS platforms, integration of AI in B2B platforms, and Geospatial Analytics. Role: • Full-stack Software Developer Co-Op. Work term to be either 8 or 12 months. Responsibilities: • Develop new frontend and backend features, including comprehensive testing and documentation. • Collaborate closely with developers to define test strategies and ensure testability of new and existing features. • Develop and maintain automated test pipelines within CI/CD workflows to support continuous integration and deployment. • Conduct regression, performance, and reliability testing to identify defects and improve system stability. • Contribute to improving test coverage, test reporting, and quality metrics dashboards. • Document test cases, automation strategies, and quality assurance processes. • Support data processing workflows and ingestion into the web platform. • Update and enhance the web application landing page to improve functionality and user experience. • Design, implement, and integrate RESTful APIs. • Manage and maintain cloud infrastructure and data services within the Azure environment. • Contribute to Agile development processes in a fast-paced, collaborative team setting. • Apply web security best practices to ensure secure development and data protection. • Rapidly learn and adopt new technologies, tools, and methodologies. Communicate effectively with team members while adhering to established processes and standards. • Job Requirements Qualifications: • Ability and willingness to work in an Agile, fast-paced development environment. • Strong programming experience with TypeScript, Python, Node.js, React and Express • Solid understanding of relational databases (RDBMS), particularly PostgreSQL. • Experience with unit testing and end-to-end (E2E) testing methodologies. • Knowledge of Docker and microservices architecture is an asset. • Experience with Azure Cloud services and infrastructure is an asset. • Familiarity with data processing and ingestion workflows is an asset. • Experience with iOS application development is an asset. • Strong sense of ownership with the ability to deliver results independently. • Ability to learn quickly, think critically, and exercise sound judgment. • Excellent problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail. Strong verbal and written communication skills to collaborate effectively, share knowledge, and provide constructive feedback. • Additional Information: A requirement of working for Tetra Tech is that you are at least 18 years of age and legally entitled to work in Canada. (A copy of a valid work permit may be required.)
